verdict.rationale: GitLab's own Git version control [gitlab-docs-7] and merge-request review [gitlab-docs-1] are documented. It also ships first-party automations: CI/CD [gitlab-docs-8], custom flows with triggers [gitlab-docs-36, gitlab-docs-59] and custom agents [gitlab-docs-35]. Agent actions are attributed in commit histories [gitlab-docs-62]. However, the evidence never states that these automation definitions are themselves stored in Git, reviewed through merge requests, or can be rolled back, so the link is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that CI/flow/agent definitions are versioned as code, a documented review workflow for changes to automations, any rollback mechanism for automations, and independent corroboration.
